settings.label: The Design
settings.heading: Drawn from the gentle geometry of things that float.
settings.body: The Drifter is inspired by the universal wonder of the hot air balloon — its rounded envelope, tapered basket, and the quiet feeling of something beautiful rising. Each piece is printed over 10–14 hours on a single Bambu Lab printer, building layer upon layer of plant-based material. The visible ridges of the FDM printing process become a signature texture — a soft, ribbed surface that catches light and invites touch. The lamp version diffuses warm, amber light through translucent PLA, casting a gentle glow that transforms a nursery corner into somewhere worth dreaming about.

settings.label: Colorways
settings.heading: Choose your sky.
settings.description: Each Drifter is printed in one of our signature Awai tones. Lamp variants use translucent material for that warm ambient glow. Sculptures are printed in our matte finish.

settings.label: Made Mindfully
settings.heading: Zero dead stock. Zero material waste.
settings.body: Every Drifter is printed to order in our studio. No warehouses of unsold inventory. No excess production. We buy filament as orders come in and print each piece individually. The PLA we use is biosourced — derived from plant starch, not petroleum. It's the gentlest way to make something beautiful.

settings.title: Plant-based
settings.description: PLA derived from corn starch. Biodegradable under industrial composting.

settings.title: Made to order
settings.description: Each piece is printed only after you place your order. Nothing sits in a warehouse.

settings.title: Local production
settings.description: Designed and fabricated in-house. No overseas factories. No container ships.

settings.title: Minimal packaging
settings.description: Kraft paper, tissue, and a sticker. Nothing you'd feel guilty about.
